title: SatOV: Restoring Spatial Priors for Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentation in Remote Sensing Imagery
abstract: arXiv:2609.22834v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVS) of remote sensing imagery is a challenging pixel-level task requiring strong generalization and adaptation to the spatial characteristics of remote sensing data. Although existing vision-language foundation models perform well in general domains, their image-level classification design weakens the spatial priors needed for high-resolution remote sensing segmentation: structural spatial relations are degraded during deep feature transformation, and fine-grained spatial details are lost during downsampling. To address these complementary deficiencies, we propose SatOV, a training-free framework for open-vocabulary remote sensing segmentation that restores spatial priors at two stages of the representation pipeline. translated_title: SatOV：面向遥感影像免训练开放词汇分割的空间先验恢复
translated_abstract: 遥感影像的开放词汇语义分割（OVS）是一项具有挑战性的像素级任务，需要强大的泛化能力以及对遥感数据空间特性的适应能力。尽管现有的视觉-语言基础模型在通用领域表现良好，但其图像级分类设计削弱了高分辨率遥感分割所需的空间先验：结构性的空间关系在深层特征变换过程中被退化，细粒度的空间细节在下采样过程中丢失。为了解决这些互补性的缺陷，我们提出了SatOV，一个用于开放词汇遥感分割的免训练框架，它在表示流水线的两个阶段恢复空间先验。具体而言，残差QQ注意力（ResQQ）从CLIP的中间层提取Query-Key自注意力，并通过残差组合方式将其与最终层的Query-Query注意力进行融合……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了免训练框架SatOV，通过在CLIP表示流水线的两个阶段（如残差QQ注意力融合中间层与最终层注意力）恢复空间先验，解决了视觉-语言模型在遥感影像开放词汇分割中空间关系退化和细节丢失的问题。
en_tdlr: SatOV is a training-free framework for open-vocabulary segmentation of remote sensing imagery that restores spatial priors at two stages of the CLIP representation pipeline, addressing the degradation of structural spatial relations and the loss of fine-grained spatial details in vision-language foundation models.
